title: 13 Things Mentally Strong People Don’t Do

questions.q: Which kind of thing does lesson 1 say not to waste energy on?
a: Things outside your control, like complaining about what you deserve
questions.why: Lesson 1 says complaining about what you think you deserve wastes energy.

questions.q: What does lesson 2 recommend doing with your Facebook feed?
a: Remove it for a while and stop comparing
Post more often to feel connected
questions.why: The lesson says to cut the news feed and see how you feel after a week.

questions.q: What does the author say comparison on social media does?
a: Makes you measure self-worth by a poor yardstick
questions.why: Lesson 2 calls it a bad yardstick for self-worth.

questions.q: What does lesson 3 say you should learn to be okay with?
questions.why: Lesson 3 is about being comfortable alone, a basis for healthy relationships.

questions.q: Why are many people uneasy about being alone, according to the summary?
questions.why: The author says society condemns just being, so we fear solitude.
